video_title: Willie Cauley-Stein on getting DUNKED on by Anthony Davis at Kentucky 😳

quotes.speaker: Willie Cauley-Stein
quotes.summary_phrase: Willie Cauley-Stein on the work ethic at Kentucky
quotes.excerpt: I put in the work. I was working, bro. We was working.
quotes.quote: I put in the work. I was working, bro. We was working. KP was working, we was working. That just helped the confidence because I'm in the gym with Devin Booker, Tyler Ulis, before that, Julius Randle.

quotes.speaker: Willie Cauley-Stein
quotes.summary_phrase: Anthony Davis dunking on Willie Cauley-Stein in practice
quotes.excerpt: Anthony Davis came back one time and we played one-on-one. Bro dunked on me crazy.

text_blocks.speaker: Willie Cauley-Stein
text_blocks.text: Anthony Davis came back one time and we played one-on-one. Bro dunked on me crazy. And I was this my sophomore year.

text_blocks.speaker: Willie Cauley-Stein
text_blocks.text: I said, oh shit. This the first time I ever been dunked on for real.

quotes.speaker: Willie Cauley-Stein
quotes.summary_phrase: Willie Cauley-Stein on his injury and missing the draft
quotes.excerpt: I was making it. I was going to go, especially if we would have won it.
quotes.quote: I was making it. I was going to go, especially if we would have won it and I would have been healthy when we won it, I was going out of there. I remember being in the hospital right after my surgery and I was on the phone with my homie, I was on FaceTime with him and we just got to talking about it. I was like, bro, I never won no accolades, I never won a state championship, I never won none of this stuff. I think I want to come back.

quotes.speaker: Willie Cauley-Stein
quotes.summary_phrase: Willie Cauley-Stein on the isolation of his injury recovery
quotes.excerpt: It was a lot of isolation. It was good and bad.
quotes.quote: It was a lot of isolation. It was good and bad. It helped me for the chip on the shoulder right there. There'd be times where I had to go sneaking in the gym because they wouldn't let me, but I'm itching to play, bro. I'm itching to like do some. And then there'd be times like you start getting in the bullshit because you ain't got nothing else to do. I don't got to go to practice when everybody else practices. I started abusing the situation a little bit, you know, started partying a little bit more.
